sentimento.text1: The presidential book holds USD 139.02M and the price on this page is from the confirmed reading of Aug 29, 2:51 PM BRT (5:51 PM UTC). The day did bring a national poll: Vox Brasil (BR-05519/2026, fieldwork Aug 25 to 27, n=2,100, margin of 2.15pp, in person), the first in two days. It brings the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) at 37.1% to 34.8% and the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) at 45.1% to 44.5% for the runner-up. The 0.6 point sits inside the margin, so the reading is a [technical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico).
sentimento.text2: On price, the runner-up rose 3.70pp, to 39.35%, the largest move on the panel, and the leader gave up 2.00pp, to 55.50%. The distance between the two fell to 16.15pp, the lowest value in the 20-day window. The series shows that narrowing running since Aug 10, when the distance was 36.40pp, without a single day of meaningful reversal. This time both sides moved, unlike the two previous days, when the leader stood still.
sentimento.text3: This round publishes no new number for the second-place and third-place contracts of the first round. Declared voting intention points to the same trailing field by another route: Vox places Ronaldo Caiado as the third name in the first round, at 5.0%, ahead of Renan Santos at 3.3%, Romeu Zema at 2.8% and Augusto Cury at 2.6%.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 39.35% (vol USD 9.23M) in the presidential book, up 3.70pp, the largest move on the panel. In Vox of Aug 29 he has 34.8% in the first round and 45.1% in the runoff, and comparing the pollster with itself shows rises of 3.6pp and 4.0pp in one month. In his TV Globo interview he tried to tie Banco Master to his opponent and promised to respect the election result, according to O Globo, and refused to account for the Dark Horse case, according to Folha de S.Paulo. He told the Faria Lima financial district that relations with the Supreme Court improve once he appoints four justices, according to Estadão.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 55.50% (vol USD 9.44M), down 2.00pp. In Vox of Aug 29 he has 37.1% in the first round, ahead by 2.3 points, and 44.5% in the runoff, behind by 0.6 point inside the margin. Against Vox own Jul 31 reading he gives up 3.4pp in the first round and 3.0pp in the runoff. His rejection is 52.7%, above the opponent 49.3%, according to CNN Brasil. In the radio advertising debut he focused on education, according to InfoMoney, called his opponent the worst of the Bolsonaros, according to Estadão, and his campaign launched a site tying the rival to militia and to Banco Master, according to Poder360.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Ronaldo Caiado is the third name in the first round in Vox of Aug 29, at 5.0%, and in the outright-winner contract he remains at 0.25% (vol USD 6.89M), below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. Renan Santos at 2.25% (vol USD 11.82M), down 0.65pp. Augusto Cury gave up 0.25pp in the outright-winner contract, to 3.25% (vol USD 2.56M), debuted on radio campaign advertising and gained 2 million followers over the week, according to SpaceMoney. This round publishes no new number for the second-place and third-place contracts of the first round.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Aug 29, 2:51 PM BRT (5:51 PM UTC). AFOS publishes only prices that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and the confirmation is done contract by contract. Names below 0.5% fall outside that watch, because a thin book swings on its own. The presidential book holds USD 139.02M since opening.

inss.text1: The case involving the president's son was the political axis of the day. The Federal Police is investigating whether a lobbyist friend of his acted at the postal service, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and allies see the president under pressure, with a strategy of outsourcing the fiscal adjustment debate to ministers. The government is aiming for a positive agenda in Congress to shift the focus, according to CNN Brasil.
inss.text2: On the campaign trail, the president held events in Bahia and avoided questions about his son's dealings inside his own administration, according to Terra. The director-general of the Federal Police said, without naming the case, that the force acts without protecting and without persecuting, and defended technical conduct.
inss.text3: The institutional crisis around the case remains escalated. André Mendonça sees no room for a truce with the Federal Police leadership, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and the president of the Supreme Court, Edson Fachin, is working to avoid the escalation, saying it is his duty to preserve institutions, according to SBT News, Brasil 247 and ICL Notícias. The panel does not date Fachin act as Friday: the coverage describes it as an effort under way.
inss.text4: ⚠️ The case remains live and unresolved. The distinction the panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on government approval is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another, and the two do not move together by default. The poll released on Friday has fieldwork from Aug 25 to 27 and measures neither this week's escalation nor the advertising debut.
inss.impactoLula: Not isolable, and today new reading does NOT reach the period in question. Vox Brasil of Aug 29 has fieldwork from Aug 25 to 27, before the escalation of the crisis between Mendonça and the Federal Police. The clean comparison it allows is the pollster against itself: 37.1% in the first round against 40.5% on Jul 31, and 44.5% in the runoff against 47.5%. On price, his outright-winner contract gave up 2.00pp on Friday, to 55.50%.
inss.impactoGestao: A new reading on Friday, and it is the most negative of the recent series: Vox Brasil brings 52.7% rejection of the president, according to CNN Brasil, and 53.3% disapproval, according to Exame. The week's earlier measurements remain available for comparison: 42% approval against 50% disapproval in PoderData of Aug 27, 46% against 50% in Indexa/Broadcast of Aug 26, 43% against 51% in Gerp of Aug 26, and 48% against 49% in BTG/Nexus of Aug 24.
inss.conclusao: On Aug 29 the case advances on two fronts at once, the investigation, with the lobbyist at the postal service, and the crisis between the court and the Federal Police. The panel records both movements and does not convert one into the other. It also records that the day's poll measures neither of them, because its fieldwork closed on Aug 27.

bancoMaster.text1: Daniel Vorcaro testimony to the Federal Police was concluded on Aug 28, and its content came out between the night of Aug 28 and Aug 29. He said he did not corrupt Central Bank staff and again signalled a plea deal, according to Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo. It was his first testimony this year on the suspicion of corruption at the Central Bank.
bancoMaster.text2: The willingness to negotiate a plea deal is the new fact, and it changes the kind of risk the case carries: an approved agreement would turn the person under investigation into a source of evidence about others. None of that is settled, and the panel records the stated willingness, not an agreement.
bancoMaster.text3: The case entered the campaign from both sides on the same day. The leader played on radio campaign advertising the audio in which his opponent calls Vorcaro brother, according to Valor Econômico, and his campaign launched a site tying the rival to the bank and to militia, according to Poder360. The opponent replied that there is nothing wrong with his relationship with Vorcaro, according to G1, and that the president is the one who owes explanations, according to Gazeta do Povo.
bancoMaster.conclusao: THE CROSSING OF THE DAY IS IN THE ORDER OF EVENTS, NOT IN THE CAUSE. The case became a central piece of campaign advertising and the content of the testimony came out between Aug 28 and Aug 29, and in the same period the runner-up price rose 3.70pp. The panel does NOT claim one produced the other, and there is a concrete reason not to: his price started rising on the night of Aug 28, before the poll came out. When two measurements move in the same direction, what gets recorded is the sequence, not the mechanism.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act captured on Aug 29.
stf.moraes: No new individual act by him on Aug 29. Governor Wilson Lima publicly defended his impeachment, according to AM POST.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act captured on Aug 29.
stf.dino: He said the judiciary's over-prominence is not desirable but that the Supreme Court cannot run away from it, according to Folha de S.Paulo. He remains one of the two poles of the internal rift over who runs the cases involving the president's son and Dark Horse.
stf.mendonca: ⭐ THE NAME OF THE DAY AT THE COURT IS HIS FOR THE FOURTH DAY RUNNING. He sees no room for a truce with the Federal Police leadership in the case involving the president's son, according to Folha de S.Paulo. He also suspended the ruling on Vale's taxation abroad. The day before he summoned X to explain to the electoral court the filter that blocks recommendations of candidate profiles.
stf.nexo: THE COURT PRESIDENCY APPEARS IN THE COVERAGE. Edson Fachin is working to reduce the tension between Mendonça and the Federal Police leadership and met with the Justice Minister, according to Brasil 247 and SBT News. The panel records the effort without dating it as a Friday act, because the coverage describes it as a process under way. Alongside it, the electoral court took X to task and demanded explanations about failures in its algorithm filter, and the runner-up went to that same court against his opponent remarks about campaign accounts, according to Poder360.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 3.45% (vol USD 84 thousand), up 0.05pp in the confirmed reading of Aug 29, 2:51 PM BRT (5:51 PM UTC). It stood at 3.40% on 13 of the last 15 days. ⚠️ It is the smallest book on the panel, and in a book that size half a percentage point does not separate news from noise: the level tells you more than the move. On Friday a governor publicly defended the impeachment of a justice, and the price barely moved.
